why: I checked both must_not items against the verifier's checks. Item 1: Check 3 gets every exported function from Object.keys(require('./math.js')) and fails if "any exported function is missing from README.md". It also says plainly that subtract had no README entry. So a README that documents clamp but not subtract would fail. Item 2: Check 2 passes on any `RangeError`, with no exact message. Check 1 tests the returned values and `typeof`, not the parameter count. Check 3 asks only that each entry "names it and describes what it does", which is what "documents" means, and sets no layout. Check 4 asks only for fail 0 and exit 0. The stricter points (the lo===hi case, the message being clear, README style, tests) are all listed under "Advisory (not part of PASS/FAIL)". The builder brief's style guidance tells the builder what to do; it doesn't add a PASS or FAIL condition. Neither item is broken.
